item.title: 18-Year-Old Arrested in Sterling City High School AG Shop Burglary
item.description: STERLING CITY, TX — An 18-year-old man was arrested, and approximately $1,700 worth of stolen tools were recovered following a January burglary at the Sterling City High School agriculture shop, the Sterling County Sheriff’s Office announced. Miguel Palacio was taken into custody after the sheriff’s office executed an arrest warrant. item.title: Registration Open for 2026 RISE Run in San Angelo
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Registration is now open for the RISE Run, a community running and walking event set for Saturday, April 25, 2026, in San Angelo. The event, which spotlights fellowship, movement, and gratitude, offers three distances: a 10K run starting at 8 a.m. CDT, a 5K run starting at 8:20 a.m. CDT, and a 1-mile walk/jog starting at 8:40 a.m. CDT. Learn More Here.

item.title: Lake Brownwood Woman Arrested After Shooting Man in Chest
item.description: LAKE BROWNWOOD, TX — A woman has been arrested after shooting a man in the chest in the town of Lake Brownwood. Erin Martin was arrested by the Brown County Sheriff’s Office for aggravated assault with a deadly weapon - family violence.According to a press release from Brown County Sheriff Vance Hill, sheriff’s deputies were dispatched to the 7100 block of Belfast Drive near Lake Brownwood regarding a domestic disturbance and a shooting victim at 6:17 p.m. Tuesday, Feb. 3, 2026. Learn More Here.

item.title: 9 Puppies Abandoned at San Angelo Animal Shelter as Facility Faces Overcapacity Crisis
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Nine puppies were dumped in a cardboard box in the driveway of San Angelo Animal Services around 5 a.m. On Wednesday, the latest incident in what the shelter described as a surge of owner surrenders that has pushed it over capacity. In a Facebook post on Wednesday, the shelter said it has been “inundated with owner surrenders” over the past week and called the abandonment of the puppies a “heartbreaking incident” that is now under investigation. Learn More Here.

item.title: San Angelo Police Seek Public's Help Identifying Motorcycle Theft Suspect
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The San Angelo Police Department is asking for the public’s assistance in identifying a male person of interest in a motorcycle theft. Authorities released surveillance images on Wednesday showing the individual and a white pickup truck that may be associated with him. Anyone who recognizes the man or has information about his identity is urged to contact San Angelo Crime Stoppers at 325-658-4357 and reference Case #2026-0000796. Learn More Here.

item.title: Dallas Mavericks Trade Anthony Davis After Only 29 Games
item.description: DALLAS, TX — The Dallas Mavericks agreed to trade 10-time All-Star Anthony Davis to the Washington Wizards in an eight-player deal that clears salary and draft capital as the franchise pivots to building around No. 1 overall pick Cooper Flagg, sources told ESPN. Learn More Here.

item.title: Air Force Member with San Angelo Ties Seeks Help After Wife's 3-Month ICE Detention
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Colby Grafa, an active-duty U.S. Air Force member from San Angelo, is appealing for public help after his Guatemalan wife was detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement for three months. Learn More Here.
